title: Listening Drill — Puppet festival schedule
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Puppet festival schedule
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the puppet festival. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns the order.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the box office. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the side passage instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Anna rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, collect a revised programme. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
